sheets.credit: Всесоюзное аэрогеологическое научно-производственное объединение «Аэрогеология», Министерство геологии СССР, Москва 1979. Native source notices retained.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 178 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1979; series/catalog 1979. South native shared legend: 178 candidate references; native historic descriptions retained, not newly transcribed. Pale and black geological colors retained. Fine rivers and shorelines are not independently reconstructed. Chimkent has a source-native unpainted southeast excluded with a manually traced source mask; boundary placement and shorelines remain approximate, not reconstructed geology.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 3.87px, leave-one-out max 26.81px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
